name: Analyze Rna Secondary Structure Features
description: Calculate numeric values for various structural features of an RNA secondary structure.
detailed_description: Calculate numeric values for various structural features of an RNA secondary structure.
when_to_use: When you need analyze rna secondary structure features analysis

parameters.dot_bracket_structure: [Required] RNA secondary structure in dot-bracket notation (e.g., "(((...)))"). Parentheses represent base pairs, dots represent unpaired bases. (str)
parameters.sequence: [Optional] The RNA sequence corresponding to the structure. If provided, sequence-dependent energy calculations will be performed.
